paragraphs.en: Carapace design facilitates rolls, and buffers against impact.
paragraphs.zh: 甲壳的设计有助于实现翻滚动作，并缓冲冲击力。

paragraphs.en: Symmetrical, parametric artifacts of the CAD build become stripes, spots, and other shapes when color is applied. The same as occurs in nature, novel forms emerge from byproducts of other processes.
paragraphs.zh: CAD 参数化建模中自然形成的对称几何特征，在赋予颜色后呈现为条纹、斑点及其他图案。正如自然界中发生的那样，新颖的形态也可以作为其他过程的副产物涌现。

paragraphs.en: Simple numerical rules applied to the topology yield complex color patterns. Similar mathematical principles are found naturally in the appearance and structure of organisms in all branches of life.
paragraphs.zh: 将简单的数值规则应用于拓扑结构，便能生成复杂的色彩图案。类似的数学原理广泛存在于自然界各类生物的外观与结构之中。
底层的简单性催生出涌现的复杂性。
